title: Only perks for 4 minutes.
text:
Only perks for 4 minutes.. Disappointing. I was looking for a 'real' Percolator and this is definitely not that. I stored it away and will probably only use it when unexpected company drops in and I need quick coffee.

PROS:
1. Stainless Steel
2. If you leave it plugged in after it stops perking, it stays really hot for a couple of hours

CONS:
1. You cant control how long this perks which means you cannot control the richness of the coffee. Turn off after 4 minutes. You cannot turn it back on (re-perk) until it cools down. I have to perk at night, then let it cool down overnight and re-perk in the morning to get a decent roast. I am using way more coffee grounds with this Percolator.
2. Extremely loud
3. The basket is narrow and tall rather than wide and short. Difficult to scoop coffee into it without spilling
4. Even when using a paper liner, grounds end up in the perked coffee
5. Very difficult to see the water level as you fill this pot. Tried turning it to different angles. Also tried turning on the counter lights.
6. Open at the top is too narrow o fit your hand in, so since you cant submerge the pot, it is not easy to clean.
